title: Support for hiring chronically ill workers such as kidney dialysis patients
asked: Whether the Ministry will consider extending wage offsets or other support to encourage hiring of chronically ill persons, such as kidney dialysis patients, who may not meet the prevailing definition of persons with disability.
response: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong said chronic illnesses are a diverse group needing a differentiated approach. Kidney dialysis patients may request flexible work schedules under the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests, while others may need workplace adjustments or modified duties worked out case-by-case. Employers can get resources such as SNEF workshops, and workers can access job matching and career advisory services from Workforce Singapore and NTUC's Employment and Employability Institute. On the Enabling Employment Credit, he said it is mainly for people with more permanent disabilities, and that the Government is working with tripartite partners and the National Kidney Foundation to raise awareness of inclusive hiring and improve matching.
